name: Web of Causation
line: The reference network cover: the real cancer network (185 exposures as group-coloured dots, 68 cancers as ink rings sized by their links, established links solid and suspected dashed) fills the first screen beside a quiet editorial column; the signature moment is the web drawing itself outward on load, then a pinned five-step story selects Tobacco smoking, then Lung cancer (the camera eases in), thins to Group 1 and ends on the lesson with its exact figures.
notes: Canvas 2D, drawn at device pixel ratio, redrawn only while something moves. Hover lights a node and its links (in the colour of each exposure's group) and names them; click or tap opens the entry card (kind, group label, link count, scrollable Established/Suspected list, 'Open in the explorer'); the search highlights matches live, has a keyboard listbox and runs the Try links; selections are announced in an aria-live region. On phones the caption, search and network stack, the card is a bottom sheet with a close button, labels are fewer and hit targets larger. The explorers' plates are drawn from graph.json and chronic-graph.json (a damped layout, because EpiNet.layout diverges on the chronic file's large hubs). Without JavaScript the hero shows media/tool-cancer-network.svg and every caption as text. Lora has Cyrillic; Work Sans (labels and interface) does not, so Russian interface text would fall back to the system sans.
